rationale: Create one canonical TransMontaigne Partners LLC manager-level operating platform for ArcLight's Pike Holdings census label. A 2021 SEC agreement defines Pike Petroleum Holdings, LLC as Pike Holdings and documents it as an intermediate sponsor shell above TransMontaigne. ArcLight obtained platform control through its February 2016 acquisition of TransMontaigne GP, and Fund VI's February 2019 take-private made TransMontaigne wholly owned. Current filings establish that TLP Finance Holdings owns 100% of TransMontaigne and is an indirect wholly owned subsidiary of ArcLight Energy Partners Fund VI, L.P. Count TransMontaigne once; do not separately count the Pike/PPH/TLP holding layers, operating subsidiaries, terminals, pipelines or other assets beneath it. Pike Corporation and Pike County Light & Power are unrelated and remain unchanged. No TransMontaigne platform-level sale or signed pending ownership transfer was identified through August 15, 2026.

afterImage.description: TransMontaigne Partners LLC is a Denver-based U.S. midstream infrastructure platform providing terminaling, storage, transportation, blending and related logistics for refined petroleum products, renewable fuels and feedstocks, crude oil, chemicals, fertilizers and other bulk liquids. Its network spans 54 terminal facilities across major U.S. markets. ArcLight acquired platform control through the general partner in February 2016, and ArcLight Energy Partners Fund VI completed the take-private in February 2019. TLP Finance Holdings now owns 100% of TransMontaigne and is an indirect wholly owned Fund VI subsidiary. Pike Holdings and Pike Petroleum Holdings are upstream sponsor-shell census labels, not separate PortCos; intermediate holding vehicles, operating subsidiaries and individual assets beneath TransMontaigne are subsumed. No platform-level sale or signed pending ownership transfer was identified through August 15, 2026.
